typical_titles: Secretary or Principal Secretary (IT / e-Governance); Chairman of the state IT agency
owns: The budget and the final approval of the tender
cares_about: Citizen reach, cost per call against the current call centre, and a clean audit trail
blocks_if: The tender is not approved by the department, or the cost model does not fit the approved budget
where_found: Leadership page of the department or agency
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: CEO or Managing Director of the state e-governance agency; Mission CEO; helpline project head
owns: The service (a helpline, a portal or a scheme) and its service targets
cares_about: Fewer long waits, more calls solved the first time, more languages covered
blocks_if: The bot lowers call quality, or citizens cannot reach a person when needed
where_found: Leadership page or 'Who's Who' page of the agency
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Helpline or call centre head; project manager at the agency
owns: Daily call handling and the human agents. The MP 181 RFP lists about 800 agents and 50000-60,000 inbound calls a day
cares_about: Hand-off to a live agent with full context, queue length, shift cover
blocks_if: The bot cannot pass a call to a person, or the agents lose context
where_found: Named in the tender document or on the helpline page
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Technical Evaluation Committee; agency CTO; NIC or NeGD technical staff
owns: The live demo and the pass or fail scoring in the RFP
cares_about: Language detection and switching, interruptions, accuracy on real calls, logs
blocks_if: The bot fails the demo. The MP RFP marks demo items 'Qualified/ Not Qualified'
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Data protection and security officer; CERT-In empanelled auditor; CAG audit
owns: Data residency, AI governance, consent and audit
cares_about: Citizen data stays in India. The MP RFP clause 7.14 bars processing outside India unless the agency approves
blocks_if: The vendor cannot show where data and logs sit
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: GeM buyer; agency purchase cell; the PSU or system integrator that holds the bid
owns: The bid process, eligibility and the contract. The Odisha RFP accepted bids only from Central or State PSUs engaged in IT/ITeS. The MP RFP exempts DPIIT-recognised startups from turnover and GST pre-qualification
cares_about: Eligibility, bid security, a clean empanelment
blocks_if: The vendor is not eligible alone. Sarvam would then need a PSU or a system integrator as the bidder (INFERENCE)
where_found: Tender document (eligibility section); GeM bid page
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Bhashini Ecosystem Enablement lead for Government and Public Services; state IT officer who runs the language projects
owns: Pushes language technology inside the state and links vendors to national programmes
cares_about: Bhashini language coverage, scheme reach in local languages
blocks_if: Prefers an in-house or Bhashini-only build
where_found: 'CEO & Our Team' page of Bhashini lists the vertical
label: INFERENCE
